ideas.pitch: An AI-powered urban canopy health monitor that uses computer vision and satellite imagery to calculate local carbon sequestration and detect urban heat islands in real-time.

ideas.title: AeroFlora-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the environment and sustainability track, offering quantifiable ecological impact metrics that judges prefer over abstract dashboards.

ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the education domain with a concrete local community problem, maximizing practical impact for resource-limited classrooms.
